description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication-related endpoints, including health check, signup, login, and password reset, with JWT token issuance and tenant-specific password hashing.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Performs a health check on tenant salt configuration, returning status flags and warnings.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Creates or updates a user with hashed password, auto-generates tenant salt if missing.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Authenticates a user, issues JWT token, supports legacy and migration schemes.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Resets user password using tenant-specific hashing, auto-generates tenant salt if missing.
